tasks.title: Establish the working baseline
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Identify repository, deployed commit, build commands, asset sources, configuration and hosting. Capture current desktop/mobile states and route inventory. Record tested vs untested findings before editing.
evidence: docs/audit/LIVE_SITE_AUDIT_RESPONSE.md §1 (repository, deployed commit, build, hosting, route inventory, local capture with the handoff tool); docs/proofs/ and docs/evidence/ for rendered states at 320/390/768/1440

tasks.title: Make RSVP status truthful
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Replace ad hoc status text with configured preopen/open/closed/unavailable states. Align all calls to action. No apparent working form while the backend is unavailable.
evidence: Configured states: rsvp.mode coming-soon|live|closed (+ post-event), rsvp.opensAt (optional, shown only when set); hero and RSVP page say responses are not open; client shows an explicit unavailable/error state with nothing lost (src/js/rsvp.js MESSAGES). Tests: scripts/test.mjs "IMP-02/07"

tasks.title: Approve privacy and architecture
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Record public-info/private-RSVP versus invitation-only choice. Select supported hosting and auth boundary without an unnecessary front-end rewrite.
evidence: Proposal recorded in docs/audit/LIVE_SITE_AUDIT_RESPONSE.md §3 (public information site + private household RSVP service on Cloudflare Workers/D1). docs/DECISION_REGISTER.md rows 2 and 14. No decision is recorded.

tasks.title: Implement household access
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Private links/code entry; random scoped credentials; rate limits; revocation; secure session; no public guest lookup. Prove household isolation in staging.
evidence: backend/ (sessions with digest-only credentials, deny-by-default, revocation); see docs/audit/BACKEND_QA_MATRIX.md. Household isolation proven by the vitest suite against a local D1, not in staging.

tasks.title: Implement response form and review
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Named guests, allowed events, explicit attendance, authorized plus-ones, conditional details, meaningful labels, review and correction.
evidence: src/js/rsvp.js wizard (named guests, per-guest per-event answers, plus-one names, conditional meals, review) + backend validation; synthetic preview at /rsvp.html?preview=1 in local/CI builds

tasks.title: Persist, confirm and reconcile
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Atomic/idempotent saves, revision conflicts, email outbox/retries, saved-result confirmation, deadline-enforced edits.
evidence: backend: requestId idempotency, revision conflicts (409), outbox in the same transaction, cutoff enforcement; docs/audit/BACKEND_QA_MATRIX.md

tasks.title: Add deadline and actionable support
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Approved cutoff and contact route in shared content, FAQ, RSVP states and privacy. Never fabricate dates or email addresses.
evidence: Single source: rsvp.cutoffAt and contact.* flow to the FAQ (answerWithCutoff), the RSVP page, the client and the privacy notice as soon as they are set (test "IMP-02/07"). The values themselves are owner inputs and remain null; nothing is fabricated. docs/DECISION_REGISTER.md rows 4 and 20.

tasks.title: Deliver coordinator operations
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Authenticated staff roles/MFA, safe import, event counts, exceptions, restricted exports, revoke/reissue and audited corrections.
evidence: backend/src/admin/* (import preview and apply, counts, exports without restricted notes, credential issue/revoke, corrections with origin) behind Cloudflare Access (staff accounts and MFA are Access policy, not code); docs/audit/BACKEND_QA_MATRIX.md

tasks.title: Reconcile privacy notice and retention
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Name actual providers; align data use, backups, access and keepsake decisions with implemented behaviour. Test deletion/restore procedures.
evidence: privacy.rsvpProvider is null and the notice says so truthfully; retention 90 days and the memories exception are drafted for approval (docs/DECISION_REGISTER.md rows 11 and 24). Deletion/restore procedure: backend/README.md, docs/RUNBOOK.md §7.

tasks.title: Refine opening and navigation
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Preserve optional reveal and current shortcuts; direct/deep links bypass the opening; accessible trigger, menu and modal; no repeated forced animation.
evidence: Seal is a <button aria-label="Open the invitation">; skip and RSVP shortcuts on the entry bar; deep links, /celebration.html and same-session returns bypass the envelope; native <dialog> with focus containment/restore; sessionStorage flag is a preference only. Proofs: entry-*, keyboard-*, reduced-motion captures.

tasks.title: Validate visual hierarchy and reflow
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Approved crest, script and charcoal text; correct closing-line size; restrained framing; no clipping at target widths. Freeze accepted screenshots.
evidence: Card face is the approved artwork with live text at its coordinates (22 Sep 2026); proofs at four widths; G2 visual sign-off still to be recorded (docs/DECISION_RECORD.md).

tasks.title: Build Our Story
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Narrative, lead photo, optional milestones/grid; conditional navigation; responsive reading order; no fabricated biography or empty public placeholders.
evidence: Section, conditional navigation, responsive order and build gating implemented; synthetic-fixture preview at /story-preview.html (local/CI only). Publishes only with approved copy and images: docs/OUR_STORY_INTAKE.md. Tests QA-06/07/08 in scripts/test.mjs. Owner decision: docs/DECISION_REGISTER.md rows 10 and 22.

tasks.title: Add approved image pipeline
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Derivatives, captions, alt text, dimensions, focal points, lazy loading, metadata removal and rights/visibility manifest.
evidence: npm run images (scripts/images.mjs): derivatives at 480/800/1200/1600 without upscaling, metadata stripped, manifest with dimensions, focal point → object-position, lazy loading of non-lead pictures, rights/visibility recorded per image. Test "IMP-13".

tasks.title: Complete venue-day logistics
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Verify booked space, reception room/entrance, arrival, transport, parking and accessibility; synchronize all destinations.
evidence: events[].venue.entrance/arrival/parking/accessibility and travel.betweenVenues stay null and omitted; docs/DECISION_REGISTER.md rows 5 and 7.

tasks.title: Expand verified travel guidance
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Airport options with official links and dated checks; remove unsupported proximity wording; retain uncertainty for December service.
evidence: Proximity wording removed ("Nearest named airport" no longer rendered); airports carry their own approvals with official sites; PNS and JKA prefilled from the audit register but unpublished until verified for December 2026. Test "IMP-15". Coordinator decision: docs/DECISION_REGISTER.md row 23.

tasks.title: Resolve accommodation treatment
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Keep general reservations or add actual contracted block terms. Add alternatives only if approved. No invented discount or booking guarantee.
evidence: General reservations retained and labelled; room block published only with its own approved terms (build-enforced).

tasks.title: Complete Questions and help
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Explicit approved cutoff, invitee rules, attire, transfer and support. Optional arrangements remain omitted until confirmed.
evidence: Deadline FAQ no longer defers to the paper invitation; attire, parking and contact FAQs stay pending and unpublished until supplied (docs/DECISION_REGISTER.md rows 4, 5, 7 and 20).

tasks.title: Validate maps and calendars
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Actual file fetch/parse/import; correct CST starts, stable identifiers, confirmed entrances, no made-up duration. Report real results.
evidence: File-level validation automated (test "QA-23": CRLF, folding, VTIMEZONE, starts at 20:00Z/22:00Z, stable UIDs, no DTEND). Apple/Google/Outlook imports and entrance confirmation remain not run.

tasks.title: Complete accessibility coverage
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Keyboard, screen readers, modal/menu, form errors, zoom/reflow, contrast, reduced motion, and mobile keyboard tests pass.
evidence: axe-core 0 violations across all states at four widths, keyboard proofs, reduced motion, 200% text (docs/evidence/ACCESSIBILITY.md, docs/proofs/). VoiceOver/NVDA sessions and mobile-keyboard tests not run.

tasks.title: Control page and media weight
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Measure budgets and five mobile lab runs; optimize without destroying imagery; keep nonessential tracking off.
evidence: Five lab runs per route within PRD budgets (docs/evidence/PERFORMANCE.md); no tracking; field data does not exist.

tasks.title: Align metadata and legacy routes
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Approved social preview/indexing, correct titles, functioning existing `.html` and anchor links; no credential leakage.
evidence: Canonical links added; titles/description from config; noindex retained pending the visibility decision; legacy routes /, /rsvp.html, /privacy.html, /#wedding-day, calendar files verified by test "QA-31". Social preview image awaits the visibility decision.

tasks.title: Release with rollback evidence
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Staging acceptance, owner approval, backup/restore check, route smoke test, operator runbook, and controlled production rollout.
evidence: Rollback: docs/RUNBOOK.md §9; deploy is a redeploy of any commit. Release authorization (G3, site.launchApproved) not recorded; strict build refuses release while blockers remain.

tasks.title: Centralize approved content
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Single event/cutoff/contact source drives UI, confirmations and calendars. Validate content states and reject public placeholders.
evidence: content/site.config.json is the single source for events, cutoff, opening date, contact, story and travel; validation rejects pending placeholders and inconsistent dates (scripts/build.mjs; tests AT-02, IMP-02/07).

tasks.title: Rehearse guest and coordinator use
tasks.implementation_and_acceptance: Six-person pilot plus coordinator reconciliation; verify real tasks, manually log remaining issues, and retest fixes.
evidence: Six-person pilot and coordinator reconciliation need a deployed staging service.

status_vocabulary.done: implemented and verified in this repository
status_vocabulary.done_lab_only: verified in a laboratory environment only
status_vocabulary.done_pending_owner_signoff: implemented; owner approval still to be recorded
status_vocabulary.built_switched_off: implemented but excluded from the public build until approved content exists
status_vocabulary.built_awaiting_originals: pipeline implemented and tested with synthetic input; no owner originals supplied
status_vocabulary.implemented_not_deployed: code and automated tests exist; not deployed to any environment
status_vocabulary.partially_done: part implemented; remaining part listed in evidence
status_vocabulary.blocked_on_owner: cannot proceed without an owner decision
